content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdobɑ bɑ kpɑm nɑ bɑ yɔ̃rɑ win wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ Setɑm tii u mɑɑ nɑ u yɔ̃rɑ ben suunu sɔɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u Setɑm bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mɑn diyɑ ɑ wee. Mɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ tem bɔsu bɔsu nɑ kɑ sikerenɑwɑ. Yerɑ nɑ den ɡɔsirɑmɑ nɑ wee.

Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Setɑm bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɛn sɔm kowo Yoobu wɑ mi? Goo sɑri wi u kɑ nùn weenɛ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ. U rɑ mɑn mɛm nɔɔwɛ. U sĩimɔ ɡem sɔɔ. U ku rɑ kɔ̃sɑ kɑ̃. U mɑɑ mɑn nɑsie. Yerɑ ɑ swɑɑ kɑsu n kɑ nùn kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ u kun mɑn ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue?
Mɑ Setɑm u wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ yɛ̃ ye tɔnu u mɔ kpuro, yerɑ u koo wɛ̃ u kɑ win wɑ̃ɑru yɑkiɑ?
À n sikin nɑ, ɑ nùn nɔmɑ dokeo ɑ wɑ. Nɑ yɛ̃ kɑm kɑm mɑ u koo nun bɔ̃rusi wunɛn tiin wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Setɑm sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee nɑ nun nùn nɔmu bɛriɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɑ ku nùn ɡo.
Mɑ Setɑm u doonɑ Yinni Gusunɔn min di. Yen biru u dɑ u Yoobu bwisi kɔ̃sunu wisi sɑɑ win wirun di sere win nɑɑsɔ.
Mɑ Yoobu u dɑ u sinɑ torom sɔɔ u siru kɛ̃kɑ suɑ u kɑ ɡɔ̃rɑmɔ.
Yerɑ win kurɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ tɛ̃, Gusunɔ wiyɑ ɑ kɑ yɔ̃rɑ mɛ? A nùn wɔnwɔ kpɑ ɑ ɡbi.
Adɑmɑ Yoobu u kurɔ wi wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡɑri mɔ̀wɑ nɡe ɡɑri bɔkɔ. A tɑmɑɑ sɑ̀ n ɡeɑ wɑɑmɔ Gusunɔn min di, sɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ wɑsi win min di? Kɑ yen de kpuro, Yoobu kun Gusunɔ ɡɑri kɑm ɡerusi.

Yoobun bɔrɔbɑ itɑ yeni, Elifɑsi Temɑɡii, kɑ Bilidɑ Suɑɡii, kɑ Sofɑɑ Nɑɑmɑɡii bɑ wɑhɑlɑ ye kpuro nuɑ ye yɑ Yoobu deemɑ, mɑ ben bɑɑwure u seemɑ sɑɑ win tem di. Bɑ wesiɑnɑ bu kɑ nɑ Yoobun mi, kpɑ bu nùn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ.

Ye bɑ wee bɑ nùn wɑ sɑrun di, yerɑ bɑ ǹ nùn tubɑ. Adɑmɑ ye bɑ nùn turuku kuɑ bɑ nùn tubɑ mɑ be kpuro bɑ wuri nɔɔ kpɛ̃ɛ. Yerɑ bɑ ben yɑbenu nɛnuɑ bɑ ɡɛ̃ɛkɑ, mɑ bɑ tii tuɑ wisi wirɔ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃.
Mɑ bɑ sinɑ kɑ wi tem mi, sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ wɔ̃kuru nɔɔbɑ yiru. Goo kun nùn ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Domi bɑ wɑ mɑ win nɔni swɑ̃ɑ te, tɑ kpɑ̃.
